hookups.source: https://summersvillelakeretreat.com/rv-sites (Premium Deluxe pull-through sites #1-#5 and #27-#32: 'All of these sites have 20/30/50 Amp Electric Service along with water and septic systems'; Standard back-in sites #6-#26 'equipped with water and 50 or 30 amp electric service'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 32 RV sites: 11 Premium Deluxe full-hookup pull-throughs (#1-#5, #27-#32) and 21 water/electric back-ins (#6-#26), which the operator calls 'well suited for the midsize Class C Motorhome, Truck Camper, or Pop-up'. Campspot lists the back-ins to 65 ft (the 50/20-amp ones to 45). Primitive tent sites, cabins and vintage-camper rentals besides. Site numbers can be moved before arrival unless a site-lock fee is paid.

sites.source: https://summersvillelakeretreat.com/rv-sites (site numbers and types) + https://summersvillelakeretreat.com/general-policies/ ('Your Site # is subject to change prior to arrival, unless a site lock fee was paid') + Campspot site types (Standard Back in RV Site max 65 ft, Standard Back in RV Site 50/20amp only 45 ft, Super Deluxe Pull Through 65 ft; read 2026-10-13)

values.note: No dump station: the deluxe sites have sewer, an on-site cleanout can be scheduled, and there is a dump station just down the road at the Battle Run recreation area. Free Wi-Fi is spotty and weakens away from the entrance gate. 15,000 sq ft dog park.

facilities.source: https://summersvillelakeretreat.com/faqs/ ('We do not have an onsite dump station'; 'We do not have public laundry facilities on-site'; 'inquire at our store'; 'over 15,000sf') + https://summersvillelakeretreat.com/general-policies/ ('Restroom and shower facilities are available on site'; INTERNET: 'We provide access free of charge ... The connection can be spotty'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Operator: 'May thru October - 2 night minimum on weekends. Off peak holidays - 2 night minimum (Thanksgiving, Christmas, New Year's Eve, Valentines Day, Easter) ~ In Peak holidays - 3 night minimum (Memorial Day, July 4th, Labor Day, Bridge Day).' Maximum 30 consecutive days; no long-term rates or seasonal sites (stay six nights, seventh free). Payment in full at booking; gate code entry; check-in 2pm.

booking.source: https://summersvillelakeretreat.com/general-policies/ (SEASONAL MINIMUMS and MAXIMUMS; 'We have a maximum stay limit of 30 consecutive days'; 'All reservations require payment in full') + https://summersvillelakeretreat.com/faqs/ ('we do not offer long term rates'), read 2026-10-21

summary: Operator's pages (behind a Cloudflare check, read in the browser): 50-amp/water/sewer confirmed; added 32 RV sites (11 full-hookup pull-throughs, 21 water/electric back-ins) to 65 ft, showers/Wi-Fi/store, no dump station or laundry, weekend (May-Oct) and holiday minimums, 30-night max. Fees left as the dated 2026-10-13 Campspot read ($48-74 site rate + $7 booking fee once per stay, no per-night fees). Season not stated by the operator. Not seasonal: 'we do not offer long term rates'.
flags: Missing phone: 304-872-5975 (operator's footer and policies page).

Waterfront re-audit lead (contrary operator claim, view direction): the FAQ says 'We overlook Summersville Lake and have a fantastic view of the lake but we do not have direct access' (lake access ~1.2 miles away), and the RV-sites page says from the Premium Deluxe sites 'you can stare out on Summersville Lake'; the entry is 'not waterfront'. A view tier may be earned for the premium sites.
